material: polished white grain, dried to 11% moisture before processing
geography: Faulkner, Lonoke, Pope and Prairie counties, Arkansas, USA
design: Observational production-field comparison; mixed model with field and field×year random effects; not randomized treatment allocation.
method: ICP-MS/MS for total As/Cd; IC-ICP-MS/MS for arsenic species. Below-detection values replaced by half the detection limit.

findings.scope: Polished grain in the sampled Arkansas fields; species subset, not all 412 samples.
Not proof of no effect or equivalence; no zero effect size assigned.

holds.issue: Methods/abstract report 103 field-years; Table 1 caption reports 107 for total As/Cd.
holds.disposition: Do not pool Table 1 summaries or assert a resolved independent denominator before supplement/raw-data reconciliation.

holds.issue: Absolute treatment-arm estimates, CIs and model tables not extracted.
holds.disposition: Narrative counterexample only; not a new quantitative mitigation/occurrence table row.

holds.issue: Article compares grain to the FDA infant-cereal action level.
holds.disposition: Do not label grain as legally noncompliant infant cereal. Product scopes differ.

overlap: Distinct Arkansas production-field series from the Delaware mesocosms; earlier Arkansas reports may reuse samples and need family reconciliation.
funding: IAFNS; USDA NIFA grants 2018-67019-27796 and 2023-67017-39185. Authors declare no conflicts.
